subject: dsa
title: Multiply Strings
summary: Schoolbook multiplication on digit arrays, no integer conversion. The product of num1[i] and num2[j] lands at result position i+j+1, carrying into i+j.
problem: Multiply two non-negative numbers given as strings and return the product as a string.

steps.caption: Multiply two numbers given as strings, digit by digit, so they never overflow. The product of num1[i] and num2[j] goes to position i+j+1.
Start with a result of all zeros, length len1 + len2 = 4.
1 (num1[0]) times 3 (num2[1]) = 3 at position 0+1+1 = 2. Add it to the 2 already there to make 5.
Result digits are [0,1,5,6]. Drop the leading zero, so the product is 156.
